source:
"11+11" is a short AVG produced by Orange Class. This script tells the story of a protagonist who is about to take the college entrance examination for the eleventh time in order to keep his promise to go to Peking University with a girl. What will he encounter on the eleventh Singles' Day? How can a successful life like Mr. Zhou and a life of playing games like Dongzi be meaningful or not lonely? Is there any meaning in persistence?
[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170620104633/http://dahao.de/zuopin/98c2de1a-4a58-11e6-888b-8038bc0baf3f]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
《11+11》是橘子班制作的短篇AVG。为了履行与一位女孩一起考上北京大学的约定，主人公即将第十一次参加高考。第十一个光棍节，他又会遇见什么？像周老师那样成功的人生，或像东子那样玩游戏的人生，要如何才算有意义，才不会孤独？坚持本身，又有意义吗？
[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170620104633/http://dahao.de/zuopin/98c2de1a-4a58-11e6-888b-8038bc0baf3f]官方网站[/url]]
